title: His Unlived Life
subtitle: Why I'm sharing my story
quote: I refuse to have experienced and witnessed so much destruction and let that be all it was and is.
label: From the essay
alt_text: An early color photograph of pink roses in a basket at the base of a stone column, above a lavender rule and an italic line on cream: I refuse to have experienced and witnessed so much destruction and let that be all it was and is. From His Unlived Life. Not Plain.

captions.facebook:
“I refuse to have experienced and witnessed so much destruction and let that be all it was and is.”

I believe that with life comes death, and with death comes life, and that we can’t have one without the other.

From His Unlived Life, on Not Plain. Read it here:
https://sarahnotplain.substack.com/p/his-unlived-life
